text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I ran like I was told to, but is<n>this really
gonna work?
Windy!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Your running just now was simply<n>splendid. I could
feel the power of<n>your determination.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Being first-rate means that you must<n>constantly
strive forward with all your<n>effort!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As such, I'd like the opportunity for<n>us to run
together, if it's no trouble.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Me, too! I'm happy to wait my turn!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (It's exactly like I was told!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr! Quit bossing me around!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If I wanna show the world my<n>greatness, then I
gotta stand higher<n>up than the rest of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This is practice for that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I don't get it! Explain it better already!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (Neeheehee! It's just like Trainer<n>said!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(If I run at full strength, then everyone<n>will tell me
I'm amazing!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess Trainer's starting to do<n>a decent job
too, in a way!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? Windy? It's quite all<n>right if you're too
busy...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Let's do it! I wanna run more so I canattract more attention!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Follow my lead!
